verdict.rationale: The Texas SOS documents a registered-agent rail. Form 401 lets a company change its registered agent and/or registered office, and it can be filed online through SOSPortal. The evidence goes no further than that one form. Nothing shows filing-service designees, authorized-provider accounts, or a way for a third party to file or act inside SOSPortal for a company. missing for 10: documented delegated or representative account access in SOSPortal, an authorized-filer or provider program, detail on what a registered agent may do for the entity, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a legal-ops lead, the service documents a sanctioned third-party rail — designees, authorized providers, registered agents, or representatives — through which a provider can act for my company

citations.quote: Form 401 - Change of Registered Agent and/or Registered Office ... File form 401 online using SOSPortal
